name: Guam
summary_text: Guam: full US federal law applies; deeply Catholic Chamorro society with strong church influence in local politics — old +0.06 delta predates the federal escalation. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United States (0.36) plus a local delta of -0.07. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Know Your Rights: Airport Security | A4TE
sources.claim_summary: Advocates for Trans Equality 'Know Your Rights' guide to US airport security (TSA): body-scanner flags, pat-downs, documentation mismatches, and how to request alternative screening - relevant to Guam as a US territory under TSA procedures.

sources.title: US State Revokes Gender-Affirming Identification | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (Mar 2026): 'US State Revokes Gender-Affirming Identification' — Kansas voids birth certificates and driver's licenses not matching sex assigned at birth; US document-policy context relevant to US territories.

sources.title: Introduction - Gender Identity and Sexual Identity in the Pacific and Hawai'i - Research Guides at University of Hawaii at Manoa
sources.claim_summary: University of Hawaii Manoa library research guide on Pacific sexual identity - resources on sexual and gender diversity across the Pacific, including Chamorro contexts relevant to Guam.

sources.title: Trump's executive order could ban transgender troops in the military : Shots - Health News : NPR
sources.claim_summary: NPR (Jan 2025): Trump's executive order could ban transgender troops from the US military - speaks of transgender identity in 'sweeping and dismissive terms'; directly affects Guam given its large US military presence.

sources.title: Guam | A4TE
sources.claim_summary: TransEquality (Advocates for Trans Equality) ID Documents Center page for Guam - information on changing gender markers on Guam identity documents.

sources.title: Guam becomes first US territory to recognise same-sex marriage | Same-sex marriage (US) | The Guardian
sources.claim_summary: The Guardian (June 2015): Guam became the first US territory to recognise same-sex marriage, after Loretta Pangelinan and Kathleen Aguero sued when denied a marriage license; marriages from the following Tuesday.
